title: Allowance Set Against a Plan Year Difference for Members Settling Grain Through the Cooperative
content:
Where a member marketing grain through the cooperative also carries a level plan on an account under Refined Fuels and Propane Accounts, an allowance is set against the difference arrived at at the close of the plan year. The size of the allowance turns on the settlements issued to the member on their Grain Marketing Contracts and on whether the energy programme takes grain proceeds at all.

1. Where the grain settlements issued to the member over the twelve months ending on the handling date reach 25000 USD and the programme allows grain settlement proceeds to be credited to the energy account, the allowance set against the difference is 120.00 USD.
2. Where those grain settlements reach 25000 USD and the programme does not allow grain settlement proceeds to be credited to the energy account, the allowance set against the difference is 60.00 USD.
3. Where those grain settlements fall under 25000 USD, the allowance set against the difference is nothing.

## What the settlement figure is

It is the net money of the settlement statements issued to the member under their Grain Marketing Contracts over the twelve months ending on the handling date, taken across the member's grain business rather than any one contract. Whether the energy programme takes grain proceeds is written in the catalogue for the programme the energy account sits on.

## The three lines as conditions and results

| Grain settlements issued in the window | The programme takes grain proceeds | Allowance set against the difference |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 25000 USD or more | Yes | 120.00 USD |
| 25000 USD or more | No | 60.00 USD |
| Under 25000 USD | Either way | Nothing |

*Hypothetical, on the boundary.* A member whose grain settlements over the window come to exactly 25000.00 USD, on an energy programme that takes grain proceeds, carries an allowance of 120.00 USD. The same member on a programme that does not take them carries 60.00 USD. At 24999.00 USD of settlements, the allowance is nothing on either programme.
